wta_1.question: Find the name and rank points of the winner who won the most times.
wta_1.sql:
WITH WinnerCounts AS (
    SELECT
        winner_id,
        COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
WinnersWithRank AS (
    SELECT
        wc.winner_id,
        p.first_name,
        p.last_name,
        m.winner_rank_points
    FROM WinnerCounts wc
    JOIN players p ON wc.winner_id = p.player_id
    JOIN matches m ON wc.winner_id = m.winner_id
)
SELECT
    first_name,
    last_name,
    winner_rank_points
FROM WinnersWithRank
ORDER BY win_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
